loop_shapes.name: Plan-Then-Execute Loop
loop_shapes.problem: High cost of committing to the wrong direction on non-trivial work.
loop_shapes.forces: Speed of starting vs. the cost of rework if the approach is wrong.
loop_shapes.solution: Draft a plan, review it, then execute against the approved plan.
loop_shapes.consequences: Adds a planning round; reduces expensive mid-execution pivots.
